items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles gave me a gig and Birdland, I think it was January 1950, with Miles, Fats, Navarro, Bud Powell, Buhaina, Art Blakey and myself, sometimes we were in there a few weeks with that band.

ctx.x: about the many people you worked [with]. So, I want to know when did you permanently move to New York and how you got to work with all these great people?
I had met them when they came to New York, and we had jam sessions. Miles would come to the jam sessions and Clifford Brown was there.
When did you move to New York permanently?
